name: Ollama
description: Get up and running with Llama 3, Mistral, DeepSeek, and other large language models locally with a single command.

name: llama.cpp
description: Port of LLM inference in pure C/C++ with zero dependencies; powers most local LLM tools and defines the GGUF format.

name: LM Studio
description: Discover, download, and run local LLMs with an intuitive chat interface and local OpenAI-compatible REST server.

name: Jan
description: Open-source, offline-first ChatGPT alternative running 100% locally on your device with multi-engine backend.

name: vLLM
description: High-throughput and memory-efficient LLM serving engine using PagedAttention, continuous batching, and chunked prefill.
hardware_reqs: NVIDIA GPUs (CUDA), AMD (ROCm), AWS Neuron, CPU

name: SGLang
description: High-performance serving framework for large language models and multi-modal models with RadixAttention for fast prefix caching.

name: Open WebUI
description: Feature-rich, self-hosted AI interface for Ollama, vLLM, and OpenAI-compatible APIs with RAG, web search, and voice.

name: Kobold.cpp
description: Single-file, zero-dependency executable for local LLM inference, text generation, and roleplay with built-in web UI.

name: ExLlamaV2
description: Ultra-fast inference library optimized for running EXL2 and GPTQ quantized models on modern NVIDIA GPUs.

name: Text Generation WebUI
description: Gradio web UI for running transformers, GPTQ, AWQ, EXL2, and GGUF models with extensive extensions and API support.

name: LocalAI
description: Drop-in REST API replacement for OpenAI APIs supporting local text generation, voice (TTS/Whisper), and image generation.
hardware_reqs: CPU, CUDA, Metal, ROCm, Intel GPU

name: Tabby
description: Self-hosted AI coding assistant offering an open-source alternative to GitHub Copilot with IDE extensions and model serving.
hardware_reqs: NVIDIA CUDA GPU, Apple Silicon, CPU
